sequential_dependency.intermediate: The halo-only grid produced by Step A, with original object cells removed.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Replace each separated nonzero object by its canonical one-cell orthogonal halo.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Choose the most frequent nonzero halo color in that intermediate (lowest color on ties) and expand only that halo one additional orthogonal step into intermediate background cells.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Step A converts object area into halo perimeter before Step B selects a color; the compact 3x3 object is largest in the input, but the six-cell line has the largest halo, so skipping A reverses the selector and changes the final grid.
